newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee ends mostly up, cocoa, sugar down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee ends mostly up, cocoa, sugar down.

text.p: COFFEE - Ends mixed after rangebound trades, shrugs off U.S. stocks draw. Jan $12 up at the close at $1,401.
COCOA - Weakens in Dec liquidation and arbitrage selling, structure widens. March down four stg at 932.
SUGAR - Lower, spotlight remains on weakening Dec/March spread in trade-related activity. Dec down $1.70 at $306.00.
